title: What only the worker sees
line: A tree worker looks down the trunk: a house like a toy under his boots. "Here we go."

title: Call your own people
line: A one-woman locksmith speaks to the women of New York City and asks them for help.
proof: Sold: up to 60 jobs a week after it, her own count

title: Worst dirt, whitest floor
line: A rug washer unrolls a rug black with mud and the first water shoots over a white floor.

title: The find, before the job
line: A bee remover opens an ordinary trash bin and the camera goes closer than we would.

title: The change runs at you
line: A local floor firm sands old grey boards; the bright stripe grows towards the lens.
proof: Seen 5,000,000 times; the next 15 films drew x2.16
